name: @w6w-apps/adyen
description: Take and manage payments on Adyen's Checkout API: sessions, payments, payment links, captures, refunds, cancels, stored payment methods and donations.

w6w.longDescription:
Adyen is a payments platform that processes cards and local payment methods for online merchants. This app drives its Checkout API (v72) from a workflow: start a payment session or a hosted payment link, submit or complete a payment, and then manage it afterwards with captures, cancels, refunds, reversals and authorised-amount updates.

It also covers the supporting calls a checkout needs: listing the payment methods available to a shopper, checking a gift card balance, looking up card brands, creating and deleting stored payment methods (tokens), listing a shopper's saved methods, running donation campaigns, and creating or cancelling partial-payment orders.

One connection holds an API key, the merchant account, and whether you are on the test environment or on your company's live endpoint. Money-moving calls carry the workflow invocation id as Adyen's Idempotency-Key, so a retried step does not charge or refund twice.
